title: North Tarrant Express

pageHeader.title: Archive: Driving Photos
pageHeader.subTitle: Westbound on managed lanes before expansion

text:
These views are westbound from the SH 183/SH 121 interchange to Loop 820. The North Tarrant Express tolled managed lanes opened in 2014. The nontolled main lanes were rebuilt and improved as part of the project, although only new auxiliary lanes were added to the main lanes.

On September 24, 2026, expansion of the tolled managed lanes to six lanes (three in each direction) was opened to traffic. The overall improvement project, which also included adding two non-toll lanes to Interstate 820 north, cost $414 million. All these photos, except the last two on the connection ramp, are no longer accurate. The interior median of the managed lanes was paved to add the new lanes. There was no change to the overall configuration of the freeway.
